title: Escalate persistent tenant-visible capability blockers by authoritative alert age

phases.objective: Use the persisted operational alert episode first_seen timestamp to apply monotonic age-based severity floors to tenant-visible capability drift without adding a schema, tenant mutation route, notification fan-out, or repair execution path.

e2e_journeys.actor: Platform Admin operational-alert synchronizer followed by tenant/admin readers
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: POST /activation/operational-attention/sync followed by GET operational-attention readback
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A continuously unresolved capability blocker remains at its source/current severity before 24 hours, becomes at least high after 24 hours, becomes critical after 72 hours, records one severity_escalated lifecycle event per actual age transition, preserves the stronger severity monotonically, and resets the age episode when a previously resolved/ignored blocker reappears.
steps: Lock the existing operational_alerts row for the stable capability-drift alert key before evaluating age.
Use persisted first_seen_at as the authoritative current-episode start for an open alert.
Apply policy capability_drift_age_escalation_v1: high floor at 24 hours and critical floor at 72 hours.
Never lower a stronger source or already-persisted severity while the blocker remains unresolved.
Persist safe age/escalation metadata in evidence and emit severity_escalated lifecycle evidence only when the age floor actually raises severity.
When a resolved or ignored capability blocker reappears, start a new age episode from the new observation instead of inheriting the prior resolved incident age.
Keep capability-drift notification fan-out and managed repair execution disabled in this slice.
assertions: The age calculation derives from operational_alerts.first_seen_at, not a cached UI counter or tenant-supplied timestamp.
Before 24 hours age does not raise severity; at 24 hours the effective severity is at least high; at 72 hours it is critical.
Age escalation is monotonic during one unresolved lifecycle episode and does not downgrade a stronger source severity.
A severity_escalated event increments lifecycle_revision and records policy/age/sync evidence without changing lifecycle_status.
A resolved or ignored prior episode does not make a newly re-emitted capability blocker immediately old or critical.
Tenant projection remains customer-safe and notificationEligible remains false for capability-drift alerts.
No migration, new table, tenant mutation endpoint, provider call, notification send, managed repair execution, Production action, or secret read is introduced.
